title: Evaluation phases
statement: Define the finite set of evaluation phases consisting of $n0$, $sep$, $skipN$, $g$, $k1$, $k2(b)$ for a Boolean $b$, $a(k,c,acc)$ and $u(k,c,acc)$ for a gate kind $k$, a three-valued index $c$, and a Boolean accumulator $acc$, together with $o$ and $fin(v)$ for a Boolean $v$. The gate kind ranges over AND, OR, and NOT.
